overview: When a standard shop is not enough, we add the model your business runs on. That can be recurring subscriptions, paid memberships, wholesale pricing with approved buyers, or a marketplace where several vendors sell in one store. We plan the rules with you first, configure and connect the right tools in your own store, and test each customer type from signup to renewal before handover.

faq: Do these features need paid extensions?
Often yes, such as WooCommerce Subscriptions or a vendor marketplace tool. We name the exact extension and its yearly price before we start, and you buy the licence in your own name.
Can you add subscriptions to products I already sell?
Yes. We set which products renew, on what schedule and at what price, and test the full cycle, including a failed payment and a cancellation.
How do B2B buyers get approved?
We create an application form, a manual approval step and a wholesale role with its own prices. Only approved buyers see those prices, and we test it with sample accounts.
Who handles tax and payouts for vendors?
You do, with your accountant. We set up commission rules and reports, and payment tools handle payouts under their own terms. We do not give tax advice.
